documents.title: Chat GPT & AI Support (sample syllabus statements)
documents.quality_note: Teaching-center page: instructors should state their AI position in the syllabus and Canvas; three OSU sample syllabus statements (no use / limited use / full use with attribution) plus quoted statements from other universities (templates).

documents.title: AI Misuse Guidelines for Instructors
documents.quality_note: Steps for suspected AI misuse: education-focused private conversation, detectors inaccurate, redo under supervision or oral exam, report confirmed violations per University Policy.

documents.title: Student Artificial Intelligence Support: Leveraging AI Tools Responsibly
documents.quality_note: Student strategies: check the syllabus first, disclose and cite AI use, verify output, AI for study aids and editing; page notes it was drafted with ChatGPT and edited by staff.
